class.name: SpineIkConstraintData
class.brief_description: Stores the setup pose for an [code]SpineIkConstraint[/code].
class.description: Stores the setup pose for an [code]SpineIkConstraint[/code]. Runtime mix values live on [code]SpineIkConstraintPose[/code]. Read the default values with [code]get_setup_pose()[/code]. See [url]http://esotericsoftware.com/spine-ik-constraints[/url] in the Spine User Guide.

method.name: get_bones
method.description: The bones that are constrained by this IK constraint.

method.name: get_scale_y_mode
method.description: Determines how scaleY changes when compress or stretch changes scaleX: none, uniform, or volume.

method.name: get_setup_pose
method.description: Returns the setup pose for this IK constraint data.

method.name: get_target
method.description: The bone that is the IK target.

method.name: set_scale_y_mode
method.description: Sets how scaleY changes when compress or stretch changes scaleX.

method.name: set_target
method.description: Sets the bone data used as the IK target.
